FERNWICK POST: "Three letters
blew off in the storm."

"If found, please bring them
to this box. Thank you!"

A soggy letter is stuck behind
the lamp. "To: Fernwick Post."

Another letter! A bit damp,
but the stamp held on.

Just a lamp now. A moth
is keeping it company.

That's all three letters!
The post box is in the square.

Not all the letters yet.
Try the lamps around town.

The letters drop into the box.
A little flag pops up: THANKS!

FERNWICK POST: "All letters
safe and sound. Thank you!"

Frost on the lamp glass.
You rub it clear. It shines!

Another lamp, wiped clean.
Its glow spills on the snow.

This lamp is already clear.
It hums, nice and warm.

All four lamps in the square
are clear. Frostspire glows!

The lamp glows bright.
No frost on it yet.

TIDE BOARD QUIZ: three
questions about Saltmere.

Answer them all for a star.
Have a go?

When is the Saltmere fish
market held?
Evenings
Mornings
Midnight

Who is the Master of the
Saltmere hall?
Nerys Bryde
Harbour Chief
Nobody

Which day are the salt pans
closed for raking?
Monday
Friday
Tuesday

Full marks! A little gold
star slides up on the board.

Not quite. The answers are
on signs all around town.

Full marks again! Your star
stays right where it is.

Maybe later. The tide
will wait. It always does.

ORE WEIGH: guess the cart's
load, 3 carts in a row.

Two right out of three wins.
Give it a go?

A cart of glowing ore rolls
onto the scale. How heavy?

The needle stops dead on it.
Spot on!

The needle swings the other
way. Not that one.

The foreman grins. "Good eye
for ore. Proper forge stock!"

The scales win this time.
The ore just sits there, smug.

Good guessing again.
The foreman just nods.

Maybe later. The carts
aren't going anywhere.
Merit +{n}!
